title: What Does GMV Mean on TikTok? A Reporting Guide
summary: Understand TikTok Shop GMV, how report definitions differ, and why GMV is not revenue, profit, settlement, or payout.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Does TikTok Shop GMV include canceled and refunded orders?


In TikTok's current U.S. Shop Analytics definition, yes. Other reports may use different order states or attribution rules, so check the definition attached to the specific dashboard.


### Can I withdraw GMV?


No. GMV is a reporting metric. Payout follows TikTok Shop's settlement process after relevant revenue, fees, shipping, adjustments, reserves, and account conditions are considered.


### Is affiliate GMV the same as creator commission?


No. Affiliate GMV is attributed merchandise value. Commission is calculated from eligible attributed sales under the applicable rate and rules.


### Why is Ads Manager GMV different from Seller Center?


The reports can use different dates, attribution windows, product scope, currency conversion, and paid-versus-organic rules. Compare definitions and order-level data before treating the difference as an error.


### Should GMV be used to measure creator profitability?


Use it as one input. Add refunds, commission, product cost, fulfillment, fees, ads, and other variable costs to evaluate contribution margin.
